blockers.finding: The Windows helper could not apply its protective ACL because the repository .git directory was owned by BUILTIN\Administrators.
blockers.resolution: Only the .git directory owner was changed to the current user; approved in-app browser startup then succeeded.

blockers.finding: The auth endpoint responds normally, and a fresh post-Prisma-repair protected-route navigation completes and redirects the unauthenticated controlled browser to the login callback.
The approved evidence browser has no authenticated Stoquify session. A fresh supplier-route navigation after the Prisma repair and server restart again redirected to the login callback.
blockers.remediation: Authenticate in the approved in-app browser after an evidence-only account has been provisioned with the required route access.

blockers.finding: A read-only database audit found zero active verified users combining the five highlighted route permissions with payroll and purchasing module access.
blockers.remediation: Provision one least-privilege evidence account or explicitly approve a multi-account evidence plan.

blockers.finding: The known payroll, supplier, and supplier-PO fixture organizations and users are absent. Their roles are split by route and no existing fixture covers the complete Phase 0 route set.
blockers.remediation: Prefer one purpose-scoped evidence account. Do not seed the current database without confirming it is an approved non-production target.

blockers.finding: Supplier and payroll fixture scripts now normalize postgresql-style datasource URLs to prisma+postgres and preserve existing local/nonlocal safety guards.
blockers.resolution: Focused fixture-connection checks were run without DB mutation: supplier and payroll helper tests validate URL normalization for postgresql/prisma formats and guard behavior.
blockers.remediation: Do not bypass the nonlocal guard or fixture environment checks when running these scripts.

blockers.finding: The representative evidence/audit route is still a placeholder rather than a concrete URL.
blockers.remediation: Resolve it before capture; /en/dashboard/people/history is a concrete candidate but requires HRIS read access and strict redaction.

blockers.finding: Shared table, date-range, payroll, and purchase-order files already contain directly overlapping user-owned changes.
blockers.remediation: After Phase 0 passes, explicitly adopt the recorded hashes as the baseline or perform hunk-level ownership isolation. Stop if a required hunk cannot be isolated.

blockers.finding: No screenshot, responsive, EN/FR, keyboard, zoom/reflow, or accessibility evidence exists yet.
blockers.remediation: Capture only after authentication, authorization, scope resolution, and a redaction-safe dataset are established.

blockers.finding: Git warns that the user-level .config/git/ignore path is not readable in the sandbox.
blockers.remediation: Repair that separate user-profile ACL only if the warning starts affecting Git behavior; it does not block the current repository audit.

blockers.finding: Two focused contract suites passed: 2 suites and 5 tests.
blockers.limitation: These static contracts do not establish browser layout, keyboard behavior, localization quality, responsive behavior, or accessibility.
